description: BALLOON FIX + stronger slices. Reverts the two spin-MAGNITUDE amplifiers (P2/P2b) that were multiplying backspin into gravity-cancelling lift, raises the slice cave's sideways-only coefficient 0.01->0.05, and doubles the situational mis-type roll so mishits stop being only the power-hold over-hit. Apply on top of loose-realism-v2 + slice-cave.

patches.name: revert P2b: assisted spin 80 -> 50 (kills lift on assisted lofted balls)
cave K_SIDE 0.01 -> 0.05 (sideways curl only; cannot cause lift)
